body.x: ION Audio (www.ionaudio.com), a leader in lifestyle consumer electronics, unveiled Sound Shine at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Sound Shine turns any two standard light bulb sockets into a stereo pair of powerful wireless speakers, streaming music wirelessly from any Bluetooth music player or smartphone. Each Sound Shine speaker can be used independently or wirelessly linked together up to 30 feet apart.Sound Shine uses LED lighting technology, giving it an estimated lifespan of 25,000 hours, approximately 20 years in normal use. They’re ideal for any lighting application that use standard light bulb threads, Each Sound Shine has illumination equivalent to a 60-watt light bulb.
